explanation: Buddhist tradition places Siddhartha Gautama's birth in the Lumbini gardens, near Nepal's border with India. Emperor Ashoka marked the site with an inscribed pillar in the 3rd century BC.

claims.text: Lumbini, the traditional birthplace of Siddhartha Gautama, the Buddha, is in Nepal.
Lumbini is not in India, Sri Lanka or Thailand.
Lumbini lies in southern Nepal, near the border with India.
The emperor Ashoka set up an inscribed stone pillar at Lumbini in the 3rd century BC, recording that the Buddha was born there.
